rules.title: Attachment rules
rules.subjectPatternHelp: Use * as wildcard. Leave empty to match any subject.
rules.tagsHelp: Pick an existing tag or type to create one. Used for filtering attachments.
rules.senderPatternHelp: Comma-separated. Patterns are exact-match unless they contain *. Use *apple.com* to match any sender containing "apple.com". Leave empty to match any sender.
rules.filenameHelp: Use * as wildcard. Only matching filenames are collected.
rules.applyToExistingLabel: Apply to existing emails after creating
rules.patternRequired: At least one pattern (sender, subject, or filename) is required
rules.deleteCounting: Checking how many saved files will be removed…
rules.deleteNoFiles: No saved files are associated with this rule. Only the rule will be removed.
rules.deleteWithFiles: {{count}} saved file(s) previously collected by this rule will also be permanently removed from this app (the original emails are not affected).
rules.footerHelp: Rules match emails during sync. Use * for wildcards. All specified patterns must match (AND logic). Filename filters which attachments are collected from matching emails.
rules.applyFailed: Could not apply the rule to existing emails. See the Output panel.

suggestions.title: Suggested rules
suggestions.subtitle: Documents that keep arriving from the same sender. Review one to create a rule, or dismiss it.
suggestions.searching: Looking for documents that keep arriving…
suggestions.patternHelp: (numbers, dates and months in the names become *)
